university.name: University of Edinburgh
university.summary: Public research university in the centre of Edinburgh, Scotland, organised into colleges covering arts, humanities and social sciences, medicine and veterinary medicine, and science and engineering. Undergraduate degrees normally last four years. International postgraduate applicants from Pakistan need a four-year bachelor's degree from an HEC recognised university.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of licensed sponsors: students, file dated 2026-09-10, listed as University of Edinburgh)

courses.title: Finance and Investment
courses.overview: One-year taught master's in the Business School covering investment, financial markets and company finance, combining current theory with applied work and quantitative methods for valuing assets and managing risk.
highlights: Compulsory foundation courses in semester one
Option courses in the final semester, or a dissertation instead
Quantitative methods for evaluating assets and managing risk
Participates in the CFA Institute CFA Program Partner Initiative (per the programme page)
courses.academic_requirements: UK first-class or 2:1 honours degree, or an equivalent overseas qualification, normally in finance, accounting, business or economics; other honours degrees considered. At least one quantitative module (for example linear algebra, calculus, probability or statistics), or relevant work experience with a significant quantitative element.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each component. TOEFL iBT: before 21 January 2026, 100 overall with at least 20 in each component; from 21 January 2026, 5.0 overall with at least 4.0 in each component. PTE and Duolingo are not listed. Tests must be no more than two years old at programme start.
courses.experience_requirements: Work experience is not required but may improve chances.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Edinburgh's Pakistan page for postgraduate study requires a bachelor's degree studied over at least 4 years from an HEC recognised university. A 2:1 corresponds to 70% or 3.5 on the 4-point scale; a first corresponds to 80% or 3.7. The programme page itself does not mention Pakistan.
courses.career_notes: Roles named on the programme page include junior trader and fund accounts analyst; the Business School runs alumni panels and an Employability and Careers Expo.
courses.application_deadline_note: Five rounds for 2027/28 entry: 2026-10-14, 2026-12-09, 2027-02-10, 2027-04-21 and 2027-06-09. A non-refundable deposit of GBP 2,500 is due within 28 days of an offer; application fee GBP 60.
courses.notes: Entry requirements and English scores also read from https://www.business-school.ed.ac.uk/msc/finance-investment/entry-requirements. Fee page labels the fee 'for entry in 2027', recorded as 2027/28. Pakistan 70% and 3.5 are the university's stated equivalents of a 2:1 for postgraduate study in general.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: One-year taught master's in the Business School on strategic direction, people leadership and responding to changing business conditions, applying contemporary management issues to practical cases.
highlights: Compulsory foundation courses in semester one
Option courses to suit career interests
Lectures, case studies, group work and tutorials
courses.academic_requirements: UK first-class or 2:1 honours degree in any subject, or an equivalent overseas qualification. The international section of the entry page refers to a 2:1 in a related subject, so the subject requirement should be confirmed.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each component. TOEFL iBT: before 21 January 2026, 100 overall with at least 20 in each component; from 21 January 2026, 5.0 overall with at least 4.0 in each component. PTE and Duolingo are not listed. Tests must be no more than two years old at programme start.
courses.experience_requirements: Work experience is not required on the main entry page, but the international section of the entry requirements page says that applications without highly relevant work or other experience will normally be rejected.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Edinburgh's Pakistan page for postgraduate study requires a bachelor's degree studied over at least 4 years from an HEC recognised university. A 2:1 corresponds to 70% or 3.5 on the 4-point scale; a first corresponds to 80% or 3.7. The programme page itself does not mention Pakistan.
courses.career_notes: Career paths named on the programme page include operations manager and project planner.
courses.application_deadline_note: Five rounds for 2027/28 entry: 2026-10-14, 2026-12-09, 2027-02-10, 2027-04-21 and 2027-06-09. A non-refundable deposit of GBP 2,500 is due within 28 days of an offer.
courses.notes: Entry requirements and English scores read from https://www.business-school.ed.ac.uk/msc/management/entry-requirements, which has an internal wording conflict on subject (any subject versus related subject). Fee page labels the fee 'for entry in 2027', recorded as 2027/28.

courses.title: Accounting and Financial Management
courses.overview: One-year taught master's in the Business School combining quantitative accounting and financial management with technology, data, ethical decision-making and sustainability, including industry-linked practical projects.
highlights: Compulsory foundation courses in semester one
Option courses tailored to career interests
International accounting standards and global financial markets
courses.academic_requirements: UK first-class or 2:1 honours degree, or an equivalent overseas qualification, normally in accounting, finance, financial management or a related discipline. Quantitative or business degrees may be considered with a strong accounting and finance background. Evidence of mathematical ability is required.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each component. TOEFL iBT: before 21 January 2026, 100 overall with at least 20 in each component; from 21 January 2026, 5.0 overall with at least 4.0 in each component. PTE and Duolingo are not listed. Tests must be no more than two years old at programme start.

courses.application_deadline_note: Five rounds for 2027/28 entry: 2026-10-14, 2026-12-09, 2027-02-10, 2027-04-21 and 2027-06-09. A non-refundable deposit of GBP 2,500 is due within 28 days of an offer.
courses.notes: Entry requirements and English scores read from https://www.business-school.ed.ac.uk/msc/accounting-financial-management/entry-requirements. Fee page labels the fee 'for entry in 2027', recorded as 2027/28.

highlights: Sector-specific uses of AI and ethical challenges
Foundational technical skills including basic programming and data-led decisions

Tests must be no more than two years old at programme start.

scholarships.name: Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: University tuition fee plus a stipend at the UKRI rate (GBP 21,805 for 2026/27) for three to four years, subject to satisfactory progress
scholarships.summary: PhD funding covering tuition and a stipend, open to UK and overseas applicants starting full-time or part-time on-campus research in 2027/28. Nationality is not taken into account. Selection is by school, using the scholarship form, reference and transcript.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applied for a PhD at Edinburgh; outstanding academic record; UK first-class or 2:1 honours degree or international equivalent; generally not already holding a PhD. Shortlisted candidates should expect an interview.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadlines vary by school (23:59 UK time): Informatics 2026-11-30; Biological Sciences 2026-11-16; Physics and Astronomy 2027-01-04 (Astrophysics) and 2027-01-22 (others); Chemistry 2027-01-11; Engineering 2027-01-14; Geosciences 2027-01-25; Mathematics 2027-02-01; Business School, Divinity, Economics, Edinburgh College of Art and most arts, humanities and social sciences schools 2027-02-02; Medicine and Veterinary Medicine to be confirmed. Informatics and Physics and Astronomy assess automatically; Biological Sciences applies directly to the school.
scholarships.notes: The page does not mention Pakistan; it states nationality is not taken into account. value_amount is the stipend figure only; tuition is additional. Eligible countries recorded as INTL plus GB because the page says UK and overseas students may apply.

scholarships.name: Graduate Scholarship Scheme (alumni tuition discount)
scholarships.value_text: 10% off the self-funded part of postgraduate tuition fees for University of Edinburgh undergraduate alumni
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for graduates of Edinburgh undergraduate degrees who go on to a postgraduate programme. It applies to home and overseas students, needs a separate online application for each programme, and has no deadline.
scholarships.criteria_text: Held an undergraduate degree from the University of Edinburgh; programme must not be on the excluded list; applies to the portion of fees paid by the student rather than another funder.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; the page advises applying before starting so the fee invoice is correct.
scholarships.notes: The 10% value is from https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/alumni-scholarships and the programme pages; the scheme page itself gives no figure, no entry year and no list of excluded programmes (held on a separate page not read). value_basis per_year is not stated by the source; confirm whether the 10% applies to one-year programmes only.
